author: Zetetic I
title: Deeper 1D CNN with Self-Attention
abstract: This submission enhances the successful Deeper 1D CNN model (ID 575) by incorporating a self-attention mechanism. After extracting hierarchical features with two convolutional blocks, a multi-head self-attention layer is applied. The hypothesis is that this will allow the model to weigh the importance of different sequence regions, focusing on the most salient motifs for prediction. This should improve context awareness and boost performance, particularly on complex sequences.
